title: Georgia School Shooting: Apalachee Tragedy Exposes Gun Culture - Gov. Kemp & Lawmakers Blamed

Marjorie Taylor Greene. This video dives deep into how these politicians' campaign ads glorify guns and contribute to the culture and laws that make such tragedies possible.
